description: This file provides the admin UI for CKEditor 5 within a Drupal project, including UI rendering, drag-and-drop sorting, and state management for toolbar buttons.

classes.name: Observable
classes.description: A class representing an observable value that notifies subscribers on change.

methods.name: getSelectedButtons
methods.description: Retrieves selected button objects based on IDs, combining available dividers and buttons.

methods.name: updateSelectedButtons
methods.description: Updates the textarea element with the current selection, dispatching a change event.

methods.name: addToSelectedButtons
methods.description: Adds a button to the selected buttons list and optionally announces the change.

methods.name: removeFromSelectedButtons
methods.description: Removes a button from the selected buttons list and optionally announces the change.

methods.name: moveWithinSelectedButtons
methods.description: Moves a button within the active buttons list based on direction.

methods.name: copyToActiveButtons
methods.description: Copies a button to the active buttons list and optionally announces the change.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the CKEditor 5 admin UI, including sortable button groups and event handlers.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Drupal behavior to initialize the CKEditor 5 admin UI, manage state, and handle interactions.
